content.value: The World Tree is independent from combat levels and the Passive Tree. It has its own level, XP bar, point pool, unlocked nodes, and node choices. Its level cap is configured independently of the number of tree nodes.

You begin at World level 1. XP needed for the next level is 75 + 6 x current World level + 0.02 x current World level squared (by default), rounded down. Each World level gained awards one point. At the configured maximum level, remaining World XP is set to zero.

World nodes use the same connected-route and draft/apply workflow as Passive nodes. New allocations must stay connected to your unlocked route or its drafted extension and fit your point budget. Choice nodes grant only the selected bonus.
Press O or select the World Tree tab in the Compendium. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, hover to inspect modifiers, and apply drafted changes when satisfied.

Node bonus descriptions are generated from the stats the node actually grants, including their values and units. Choice nodes list alternatives: choose one bonus, rather than gaining every listed option. Hold Show Details (Shift by default) to enter the tooltip and click a bonus for its explanation in the Compendium.
